p: Jordan: Which according to the Hebrews was in March, about 40 days after Moses' death.
three days: Which was given to prepare food Jos 1:11.
in Jordan: Even in the channel where the stream had run, Jos 3:17
Hereby ye shall know that the: By this miracle in dividing the water.
twelve men out of the tribes: Who would set up twelve stones in remembrance of the benefit.
banks all the time of harvest: Because the river was accustomed at this time to be full, the miracle is so much greater.
firm on dry ground in the: Either tarrying till the people were past, or as some read, sure, as though they had been on dry land.
